params.name: fields
params.description: Comma separated list of fields to generate facets for. Supported fields are - year, make, model, trim, exterior_color, interior_color, drivetrain, vehicle_type, car_type, body_style, body_subtype, doors.

params.name: api_key
params.description: The API Authentication Key. Mandatory with all API calls.

params.name: vin
params.description: VIN as a reference to the type of car for which facets data is to be returned

items.docs: [Merged with the /search API - Please check the 'facets' parameter to the Search API above] Get the facets for the given simple filter criteria (by given VIN's basic specification, Or by Year, Make, Model, Trim criteria) and facet fields.
